facts.fact: A StackAdapt campaign must run for at least one day before the Suggestions Hub starts making recommendations.
facts.quote: A campaign needs to run for at least a day for the Suggestions Hub to start making recommendations.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends making one optimization per day per metric so that the effects of each change can be observed.
facts.quote: We recommend making one optimization per day per metric, so you have time to observe their effects to know what is or isn’t working.

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's Suggestions Hub, a suggested change is not applied until the user clicks "apply".
facts.quote: a change won’t be made until you hit “apply,” giving you the control to pick and choose the tips
